title: Canonical scalar maps for normalized Kummer stratum detection
statement: Let $p,\ell$ be primes, let $\Omega$ be the normed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $E$ be a finite intermediate field. Write $C_F=C(-,F)$ and $t:C_E\to C_\Omega$ for the all-continuous coefficient rings and inclusion carried by [def-sfb-kummer-coefficient-models]. On a scheme $S$, let $T_S=C_{\Omega,S}\otimes^L_{C_{E,S}}-$ be the ordinary unbounded scalar functor of [def-sfb-all-continuous-scalar-mate]. For a finite set $A$ and $I\subseteq A$, put $G_I=(\prod_{q\ne p}\mathbf Z_q)^I$ as in [def-sfb-kummer-stratum-geometry]. For a finite-dimensional continuous $E$-representation $M$ of $G_I$ and its two all-continuous condensations with insertion-of-one unit [def-sfb-kummer-coefficient-models], let $N_F=R\Gamma_{G_I}(M_F)$ using [def-sfb-condensed-derived-invariants]. Define $\rho:N_E\to\operatorname{Res}N_\Omega$ by the recorded derived coefficient map applied to that actual unit and the exact restriction/single comparison, and define $\sigma:C_\Omega\otimes^L_{C_E}N_E\to N_\Omega$ to be its scalar adjunct. Let $P_{F,S}=p_S^*$ be the actual point inverse image [def-sfb-condensed-point-pullback-comparisons]. Derive the ordinary exact module restriction/point comparison to get $P_{\Omega,S}\operatorname{Res}_S\simeq\operatorname{Res}P_{E,S}$, in functor-composition notation. Define $T_SP_{E,S}N\to P_{\Omega,S}(C_\Omega\otimes^L_{C_E}N)$ as the scalar adjunct of $P_{E,S}$ applied to the scalar unit followed by the inverse restriction/point comparison. Define the point-pulled $\rho$ with that restriction comparison, and the point-pulled $\sigma$ preceded by this scalar comparison. For $a:W\to Y$, a $C_{E,W}$-module $L$, and $v:S\to Y$, define $\iota:T_W(L[0])\to(C_{\Omega,W}\otimes_{C_{E,W}}L)[0]$ by the scalar-unit/single construction [def-pur-vector-purity-scalar-single], and $\Theta=Ra_*(\iota)\circ\beta_{a,L[0]}$ using the prescribed mate [def-sfb-all-continuous-scalar-mate]. The source restricted open image is [def-sfb-kummer-local-source], and its exact restriction and coefficient-unit-induced map are [def-sfb-kummer-scalar-restriction]. Include the component of the prescribed geometric scalar/pullback comparison at any unbounded derived object. These are canonical composites of the stated units, adjunction bijections and comparisons, with no freely supplied arrow, boundedness or completion.
